metaDescription: Standard Poodle vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Standard Poodle boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Standard Poodle social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Standard Poodle exposure.

Weight range 40-70 lb (18-32 kg) and grooming needs (Professional clips every 6-8 weeks; non-shedding coat mats without care.) belong in the same Standard Poodle household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.

If your Standard Poodle is also monitored for progressive retinal atrophy (pra), ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Standard Poodle appointments.
After the Standard Poodle puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Standard Poodle boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Standard Poodle row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Standard Poodle item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Standard Poodle kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Standard Poodle due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Standard Poodle core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Standard Poodle misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Standard Poodle health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Standard Poodle adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
